protocol:
1. Pipette liquid from a microcentrifuge tube into a well of a white tube rack using a micropipette.
2. Transfer samples from tubes stored on ice into the white tube rack.
3. Load samples from the white tube rack into the wells of an Invitrogen E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette using a micropipette.
4. Insert the loaded E-Gel EX cassette into the Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap Electrophoresis Device.
5. Close the lid of the E-Gel Power Snap device and select a program on the touchscreen to begin the electrophoresis run.
